searchText: Hi all, not sure if this is the right place to ask questions about the Beacon Chain spec. I was looking at the definition of `is_slashable_validator`: ``` def is_slashable_validator(validator: Validator, epoch: Epoch) -> bool: return (not validator.slashed) and (validator.activation_epoch <= epoch < validator.withdrawable_epoch) ``` So it seems that validators are slashable even after they have exited. I was wondering if this is actually currently possible, since as far as I know validators cannot attest/propose anymore after exiting, so how would they get slashed? The idea is to give slashers reasonable time to find slashable attestations (and conversely to avoid validators being able to exit and then publish conflicting attestations for the time just before they exited when they were still active). Got it, thanks!
